SASBDB entry SASDVG2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVG2/)

Publication: S. aureus Eap is a polyvalent inhibitor of neutrophil serine proteases
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2024.107627

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDVG2/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
